name: fi-income-tax
description: Prepare Finnish individual income-tax computations for tax year 2026 covering wages, benefits, pensions, dividends, investment disposals, rental income and ordinary sole-trader profits. Establish earned and capital income, calculate statutory deductions and credits, select municipal and parish rates, and reconcile state tax, health contributions and broadcasting tax. Use for Form 5, business profit allocation, 2026 commuting costs, household credit, pension deductions, dividend splits, capital losses and personal assessment. Includes two executable examples, current statutory references and explicit distinctions between final liability and withholding. Cross-border residence and relief use the linked individual cross-border skill; Åland municipal differences require the separate regional schedule.
